accessibility_and_contrast.table_scannability: Alternating subtle row hover, explicit column headers, keyboard accessible modal and dropdown controls.

testing_attributes.rules: Every button, input, tab, filter, navigation link, table row action, modal trigger, status badge, and KPI card MUST carry explicit `data-testid` attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent.architecture_and_framework: Implement standard farm-ts (FastAPI backend with Motor MongoDB + Vite React 19 frontend). Ensure all 11 modules are fully functional with realistic seed data.
instructions_to_main_agent.language: Bahasa Indonesia interface labels, buttons, tables, and dialogs (e.g. 'Tambah Pelanggan', 'Simpan Quotation', 'Konfirmasi Pesanan', 'Filter Rentang Tanggal'). Currency format: Indonesian Rupiah (Rp X.XXX.XXX) using Intl.NumberFormat('id-ID').
instructions_to_main_agent.seed_data_richness: Pre-seed at least 15 active Customers with contacts, 20 Pipeline Deals across all 5 stages, 15 Quotations with realistic multiple line items and auto QT-2026-XXXX numbering, 12 Purchase Orders, 15 Order Monitoring items with varying ETAs (On Time, Due Soon, Overdue), 25 Activities (Today, Upcoming, Overdue, Completed), 5 Sales Team members with calculated KPI targets vs achievements, 10 Product masters with SKU and unit prices, and Audit Logs for trackability.
instructions_to_main_agent.role_simulation: Include a quick role switcher in the user profile / header (SUPER_ADMIN, SALES_MANAGER, SALES) so the user can test permissions (e.g. SALES can only manage their own leads/deals and create quotes; SALES_MANAGER approves quotations and reviews all team KPIs; SUPER_ADMIN has full system access, user management, and audit log inspection).
instructions_to_main_agent.view_modes: In Sales Pipeline, provide an instant toggle between Kanban View and Table View.
instructions_to_main_agent.export_features: Provide 'Cetak / PDF' on Quotations and 'Export CSV' on all major tables (Customers, Deals, Quotations, Orders, Sales Team).
instructions_to_main_agent.performance: Use optimistic UI or clean React Query mutations, instant client-side tab switching, and loading skeletons on table/card regions during data fetch.
